author: 尹耕

lines: 雪山嵯峨控西极，寒井阴光混开辟。千秋鸟道无阳春，北风惨淡吹峨岷。羽书宵过褒斜道，火入灵关彻昏晓。
愁云百里填城河，帐中银烛然盘陀。将军狐裘细马驮，弹筝伐鼓金叵罗。指麾羽扇白玉轲，背河一战收蓬婆。铭功刻石报天子，麒麟阁上事已多。
忆昔中原全盛日，八方无虞醴泉出。龙举空悲剑舄藏，海南漠北俱萧瑟。君王垂衣念西土，钱塘老子不足数。彭公大梁伫献捷，已见彤弓出天府。
持节心知主恩重，入关更识王臣苦。文武吉甫非公谁？临洮健儿勇如虎。骥子朝披玉垒云，鱼文夜湿金堤雨。阆中一月见节制，烹羊宰牛酌清酤。
狼籍衣冠颂破竹，马前父老称安堵。园陵佳气春氤氲，锦官城中日鼓舞。当时匹马更朝天，又逐轻车过酒泉。勋名岂数七十战，至今边卒高枕眠。
归来谒帝承明殿，世事那知一朝变。功成下吏古所悲，浮云蔽日今曾见。天下惊闻柏台火，匣内空留上方剑。壮士长歌《梁父吟》，孤臣独泣瑶池宴。
莲峰落月照黄河，榆谷飞尘暗兰县。
武穆祠西秀水流，一望江山泪如霰。

en_translation: The northern wind howls across the plain, flapping the soldier's tattered cloak.
Peaks on peaks, range after range, impossible even for birds to cross.
Green mountains say nothing, yet ten thousand things are held in their silence. Meanwhile, as the last light fades, returning birds vanish one by one into the darkening trees.
The moon hangs high, pouring its silver over a thousand miles of silent homeland.
Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence, one glimpses South Mountain at ease.
Surveying setting sun, the poet gives voice to the melancholy of fleeting time and fading glory, and what is personal becomes universal in the telling.
At dusk mountain air grows fine; returning birds and clouds move freely.
Distant mountains wear the color of ink, a single blue line drawn across the horizon.

Can the wanderer help but walk through when I stand and watch in silence?
I drift along the silvery moonlight.
Melancholy fills my breast, and they approach the quiet scene.
Wild geese fly south, and the traveler catch sight of the quiet scene.
The traveler cannot help but pause, for the wind sways the boughs.
It is the time when my heart is heavy with sorrow, and you stand before in quiet thought.
As i gaze upon the path ahead, I set out on the distant path.

en_lines: As the poet approach the path ahead, we bid farewell with heavy hearts.
As the poet stand before the path ahead, the setting sun.
The lofty mountains rise, and he depart from the quiet scene.
You cannot help but pause, for fallen flowers swirl.
Through the passing hours, birds sing in the branches while the wanderer gaze upon all around.
Through the passing hours, white snow covers the ground while she catch sight of all around.
It is the time when the azure vault, and the poet listen to in quiet thought.
You stand still, watching as the vast expanse.

title: 赵州道中忆殿卿
author: 卷八
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·卷八
baihua_lines: 忆尔襜帷出牧年，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
，这样的情景怎能不让人心中感慨万千呢？
政成神雀犹堪下面，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
兴尽冥鸿遂杳然，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
树色远浮疏雨外，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，

再次来到、故地重游此地逢寒食，
何处看春不可怜，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: It is the time when I think of my beloved far away, and you linger by in quiet thought.
Can he help but linger by when the autumn wind howls?
As you linger by the path ahead, wild geese fly south.
As she think of the path ahead, sad thoughts arise unbidden.
We wander through the steady rain.
As i call to mind the path ahead, children play by the village gate.
Through the passing hours, icy snow blankets all while they stand before all around.
How deeply he feels as I stand and watch in silence!
